What do Runway and Higgsfield plans cost, and what happened to Unlimited?

On Nov 17, 2026, Runway’s public pricing page still listed Free, Standard, Pro, and Max for individuals. Free is $0 with 125 one-time credits. Standard is $15 a month, or $12 a month billed yearly, with 625 credits a month. Pro is $35 a month, or $28 a month billed yearly, with 2,250 credits. Max is $95 a month, or $76 a month billed yearly, with 9,500 credits and a one-month credit rollover. There is no plan named Unlimited for new buyers on that page. <a href="https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/52068047744019-Unlimited-plan-is-switching-to-Max" rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank">Unlimited plan is switching to Max</a>, last fully read Nov 15, 2026, says eligible legacy Unlimited plans stay unchanged through November 30, 2026, then monthly plans move to Max at $95 a month. Higgsfield’s catalog plans, checked Nov 24, 2026, are Starter $19 a month for 270 credits, Plus $59 monthly or $30 a month billed annually for 1,200 credits, and Ultra $129 monthly or $45 a month billed annually for 3,000 credits (Black Friday sale price until Nov 25, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT)). The longer official-plan walkthrough is in Runway pricing per second.

    Which option is best for each use?

    Higgsfield Ultra (annual) is best for the lowest catalog rate we track on Wan 3.0 and several other non-Runway models, if you use every paid credit. It is not for a Gen-4 or Gen-4.5 price we can show, because those Higgsfield rows do not exist in the catalog. Runway API is best for official Gen-4 Turbo or Gen-4.5 rates, and for Grok Imagine 1.5 Lite at 480p. It is not the cheapest catalog route for Veo 3.1, where Higgsfield Ultra (annual) Veo 3.1 Fast is lower. Krea is not in the per-second ranking, because Krea does not publish a per-second or per-model video price. No line is given for a Higgsfield Gen-4 rate.

    • Higgsfield Ultra (annual). Best for: the lowest catalog rate we track on Wan 3.0 and several other non-Runway models, if you use every paid credit. Not for: a Gen-4 or Gen-4.5 price we can show. Higgsfield’s pricing page.
    • Runway API. Best for: official Gen-4 Turbo or Gen-4.5 rates, and Grok Imagine 1.5 Lite at 480p. Not for: the lowest catalog Veo 3.1 rate, which is Higgsfield Ultra (annual) Veo 3.1 Fast. Runway API pricing.
    • Krea plans. Best for: Krea’s own plan prices and unit allowances. Not for: a per-second catalog rate — Krea does not publish one, so VidFare does not compute one. Krea’s pricing page. Related: Krea AI video plan prices.

    How do we calculate this?

    Each dollar figure is a current price row, with the vendor page and the date that page was checked. A published rate is a dollars-per-second figure on that page, or an API credit count times the credit price the page states. A credit-plan figure is plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and it assumes every credit you pay for is used. When the vendor marks that count with "~", "roughly", or "estimated", the row is labelled estimated from credit plan and is not a list price. A promo shows its end date when the vendor gave one. The full method is on the about page.
